derived_measurements.manual_rejection_rule: Do not use ambiguous manually matched points with reprojection residual above 2.5 px at image width780; rejected measurements retained in raw diagnostic JSON

observed_vs_inferred.observed: visible object categories, visible silhouettes, surface palette, metric camera frame, local measured depths, selected RGB correspondences
observed_vs_inferred.inferred: backsides and internal structures, thickness of panels and furniture shells, mechanical attachment, leaf and wicker detail, material BRDF and light intensity, all physical friction/restitution

limitations: MapAnything depth is inconsistent across windows even with supplied metric poses. Modeling reconciles per-surface local evidence and RGB triangulation without secretly scaling depths.
Room dimensions and high suspended lights remain approximate; unseen portions are inferred.
AABBs are conservative collision proxies and may enclose foliage or curved furniture empty space.
Procedural shader micro-bump is primarily represented in BLEND; GLB retains colors, packed image textures and explicit weave geometry.
No quantitative fidelity claim is made before independent evaluation.
Unresolved clean-review findings are explicitly listed in review_response.json (remaining pendant correspondence, manual furniture fit residual, and appearance).
Uncertainty distances are heuristic author estimates of inconsistent evidence, not calibrated error bounds.
The near furniture uses an inferred common z0.42 seat-top plane; manual multi-view contour residuals are recorded.
